description: Preview exactly how your text will look as a realistic LinkedIn post before you publish.

faqs.a: Type your post text, pick an optional image and name/headline, and the tool renders a LinkedIn-style post mock with realistic chrome.
No — this is a visual mock only. Copy the text and paste it into LinkedIn to publish for real.
LinkedIn collapses long posts behind '…see more' — the preview shows where the fold happens (~210 characters).
Line breaks you type are preserved in the preview, so you can design your hook and spacing.

howto: Type your post text exactly as you would publish it.
Add your name, headline and an optional image.
See the realistic LinkedIn mock with the see-more fold marked.
Copy the text and paste it into LinkedIn to publish.
title: LinkedIn Post Preview
